Håndboken følger programmet og kan leses: This guide is included with the application and works offline. Select a chapter or search for your task.
Radio, mottak, sending og felleslogg. MY: Radio, reception, transmission and the shared log. MY SHACK manages your account, Cloud and status. Digital handles audio, CAT/PTT and message sequences.
Kart, stasjoner, loggkilder og levering: Map, stations, log sources and delivery to log services. Open this guide with User guide at the top of Map. Shortcuts/F1 displays the keyboard shortcut list.
digital-workflow:
1. Select your station, the correct mode and band. Check radio frequency, USB/data audio, CAT/PTT and UTC.
  2. Start receiving with MONITOR and check decodes and audio level.
  3. Select the other station and the correct TX period/message sequence in Digital. Automatic decoding is separate from automatic transmission.
  4. Follow the report exchange and completion. Check that the completed contact appears in the shared log.
  5. STOP TX stops transmission. STOP MONITOR stops receiving. Stop transmitting before changing radio settings or updating.

Options and messages depend on mode and profile. Mobile has its own Auto TX setup, described in its user guide. MY SHACK's UDP receiver does not control the transmitter.
App-logg, lokale filer og feilsøking: Application log, local files and troubleshooting
map-files:
Under Settings → Log integrations, App Log(s) lists files Map monitors from logging applications. Check that the active hamnavigator.adi is included. Use Read local log if a saved contact has not appeared. Extra files under Local File(s) are separate data sources; an old desktop copy does not automatically become the active shared log.

Import log reads a selected file into Map. Check MY SHACK before assuming a Map import is in the shared Cloud log. Use MY SHACK's Import ADIF to add contacts to the shared log.

An empty background map may be caused by map tiles/network access; missing stations by UDP or filters; missing QSOs by the wrong log file or an incomplete/unsaved contact. Change log accounts under Log integrations and the application connection under Station and connection.
